about: Where each sung phrase of the sampled stretch starts and ends, in seconds into the source record at its original speed. Found with tools/find_phrases.py and a closer look at the vocal's loudness around each cut. Two lines of this chorus open with a three-word phrase, then a breath, then the rest: the cut goes before the first of those words, not in the breath after them. Where the lead-in is still ringing there is no silence to cut in, so that cut is placed by the timing of the same words four bars later. match_sample.py cuts one pad per phrase from these.
